Note from a consultant community paediatrician
----------------------------------------------

Reviewing a 9-year-old ahead of a genetics referral. Autism diagnosed age 4, moderate
intellectual disability, and several dysmorphic features — hypertelorism, a broad nasal
bridge, and fifth-finger clinodactyly noted by two clinicians independently.

What has already been sent, all reported as normal:

  - Karyotype, 2016
  - FISH for 22q11 deletion, 2016
  - Chromosomal microarray, 2018

No exome or genome sequencing. No fragile X testing that I can find anywhere in the
record.

I am writing the referral this week and I need to be precise about the basis for it.
What is indicated at this point, and on whose authority exactly — I want to cite the
actual document, not "current best practice". We are in Glasgow, so please be careful
about which framework applies to us.
